definitions.explanation: A liquid secreted by organs in the digestive system that breaks down food. Includes gastric juice, bile, pancreatic juice, and intestinal fluids.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胃|い}→胃：01706_i⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{消化液|しょうかえき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{消化液|しょうかえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{分解|ぶんかい}する→分解する：21320_bunkaisuru⟧。

⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{消化液|しょうかえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{消化不良|しょうかふりょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When the secretion of digestive fluids decreases due to stress, it can lead to indigestion.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧ (digestion) + ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ (liquid/fluid). A standard biology and health term. The ⟦{液|えき}→液：02270_eki⟧ suffix is used for many bodily and chemical fluids: ⟦{血液|けつえき}→血液：02703_ketsueki⟧ (blood), ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧ (saliva), {体液|たいえき} (body fluid).

The main types of {消化液|しょうかえき}:
- {胃液|いえき}: gastric juice
- ⟦{胆汁|たんじゅう}→胆汁：29099_tanjuu⟧: bile
- {膵液|すいえき}: pancreatic juice
- {腸液|ちょうえき}: intestinal fluid

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {消化液|しょうかえき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分泌|ぶんぴつ}→分泌：25492_bunpitsu⟧: secretion of digestive fluids
- {消化液|しょうかえき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: digestive fluids come out
- {消化液|しょうかえき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{溶|と}かす→溶かす：08264_tokasu⟧: to dissolve with digestive fluid

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胃液|いえき}: gastric juice — specifically the digestive fluid in the stomach
- {消化酵素|しょうかこうそ}: digestive enzyme — the active chemical component within digestive fluids
- ⟦{唾液|だえき}→唾液：15943_daeki⟧: saliva — also contains digestive enzymes, but primarily associated with the mouth
